svg.text: All data (weight / measures) are indicated with a tolerance of 5%.
Chassis: definition of the carriers different from the original commercial definitions of the chassis manufacturers.
Unladen weight: the figures in the catalogue are based on the standard specification for each model, including the engine, gearbox and standard equipment.

Any accessories installed optionally or by the distributor are not included in the definition of the vehicle's unladen weight. The weight of these elements must therefore be deducted from the vehicle's payload.
